title: Nabal
summary: Raleigh names Nabal in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Nabal, named with Abigail after Samuel died, with whom Dauid had passage in the desart before hee spared Saul the second time. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. V, sig. 289b–290a
